tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (oṃ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru bu
(oṃ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru bu

tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha sidhā ye/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med dang*// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// byin rlabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// cho ga'i rim pa cung zad bri// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla chen 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge las rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang hūm̐ bdun zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dang gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur bar bsam/ ldang ba'i tshe rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang zhes pa'i bar rje btsun rat+na ni rā bho gas mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar bya'o// mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ wam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du/ kam̐ las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/

e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar sogs nas zhes bskor te/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas shudho3haṃ/ mchod pa byin rlabs snga ma ltar las shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī kun la sbyar nas ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i rū pa sogs/ par+she kā ma gu ṇa pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas 'bul/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seṅge pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro pa dang pham thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal gyo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams seṅge sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// lha mchog seṅge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// bud+dha sedha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ oṃ sogs nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du/

gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud sogs nas ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar ma rgyud spyi ltar bya'o// 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi rang gi lce la myang ngo*// na mo chos kyi sogs nas swā hās yid mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang sogs nas ha ho hrīḥ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su oṃ ā ka ro sogs nas phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtor chog ltar phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bde mchog ltar bya'o// de nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha rgyan pa'i bum pa'i chu'i dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas sogs nas/ thim zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis chu rgyun zags pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ sum+bha ni dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ha sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs bzlas/ slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ 'dod don gsol gdab dang he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal me tog bum pa dang bcas sta gon byas/ de nas byin brlabs kyi 'jug pa nas brtsams te spyad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin/ bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gtor ma skabs 'dir phul kyang rung bas gang bde byas pas chog go /gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ bde mchog lū nag sogs gang rung gi dbang thob pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa nang gshin pa rnams khrus byas nas g.yon bskor du gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o snyam pa bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i byin rlabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ gtso bor mchog sgrub pa la dmar mo skor gsum dang*/ las rgyas pa la dmar po skor gsum dang bcas pa las/ da lan 'dir dmar mo skor gsum gyi phyogs yin/ de la yang rje btsun nā ro ta pas bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa la brten nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang*/ lam gyi cha rkyen la sogs pa rnams mdzad/ de rnams la nā ro mkha' spyod zhes grags so// yang rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu tis rgyud de nyid la brten nas/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ sngags btu ba la sogs pa'i gdams pa dang bcas pa rnams la in+d+ra mkha' spyod zhes yongs su grags pa dang*/

yang grub chen mai tri pas rgyud ral pa gyen brdzes la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa la/ mai tri mkha' spyod ces grags pa rnams su yod pas/ 'dir grub chen nā ro pa'i phyogs la brten pa yin/ de la yang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma dang*/ lam gyi cha rkyen pra sen dbab pa dang*/ lang ka li ya la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis rlabs pa sgrub par byed pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag la sogs pa gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'di'i byin rlabs thob cing*/ chags med rgyun du byed pa zhig dgos/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ dbang thob cing byin rlabs don du gnyer ba dam tshig dang sdom pa la tshul bzhin du srung sdom byed pa'i slob ma zhig la bstan par bya ba yin la/ nam bya ba'i dus ni rtsa rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces gsungs pas gtso bor 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ mthun rkyen bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsog par byed pa la yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang gnyis yod pa las/ da lan 'dir yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la mi bya ste/ dus tshes ma dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba la mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pas/ mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod bstod bya ba/

gtor ma 'bul ba/ bum pa sgrub pa/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i byin rlabs thams cad slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs dgos pa rnams sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul gyis bskur ba dang rnam pa gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du/ slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag thal mo sbyar te me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/ gang gi drin nas bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje nas 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang skyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ aḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong du mjal du mi gtub pas u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re byin par mos par mdzod/ aḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba gtad nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hī'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te khyed rnams la byin gyis rlabs pa sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi khyed rang rnams kyi ljags thog dang sku lus la gtor te srung bar byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing de ltar lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing zag med kyi bde bas byin gyis rlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

de nas sems bskyed pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa bco lnga'i nya gang ba lta bu skya 'khyil ba re gsal btab la/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gyen du langs par byung bar mos te/ bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs zhes brjod nas slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sogs brjod/ zhes pas dbyer med du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod thams cad snod du mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas mgo dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid nas shar du 'khod par mos pa mdzad do// rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa byas/

de dag gi spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi pha mas thog drangs mkha' khyab kyi bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsag pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ ces rgyud dag par byas nas mdor na rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs gsum zhes sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du bzung nas/ slar yang de dag gi spyan sngar dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// he ru ka dpal sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung*// zhes dam tshig bzung ba dang bcas pa ni sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa la/ de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab par gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/

'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rnams kyi lte ba'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig sogs nas zhes pa dmar 'khyir gyis 'khor bar mos pa mdzod/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod thams cad la phog pas yongs su dag pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer de rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par mos/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo ste go cha rnams kyang ngo bo lha yin pa la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su gsal lam gyis btab nas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul gyis byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song bas lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig la thim pas de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can du gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon gyis oṃ oṃ sogs brjod cing ting lo byin/ khyed rang rnams dmigs= khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku de bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bde ba chen po'i gar stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ dmigs= lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spang pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes= slar yang dmigs= khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad dkar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du dmar 'khyil gyis 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes= yang dmigs= snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' skor gyi sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ chos 'byung gi dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba dang*/ phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba rnams la dus gcig tu shes pa gtad pas khyed rnams kyi rgyud la bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs mi phyed pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams na mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar gnyis su med par thim par mos pa mdzod/

slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams sogs nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi ḍā dril rol mo sogs dang ngag tu oṃ gsum ma sogs brjod/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya ba'i phyir du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor ba ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ rim pa ltar byon nas g.yon pa'i phyag gi me tog de rje btsun ma'i dbu la phul bar mos te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsungs shing me tog 'dor bar zhu/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste sngags kyi phreng bas byin gyis rlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyi oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig ras lhan cig tu phye nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ 'og gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i dkyil 'khor brda'am mtshan ma tsam yin la/ de'i steng du 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng du thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur bla re/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gnyis brtsegs yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang pas sogs nas bzhugs pa/

mdor na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gdos bcas kyi rnam pa ma yin pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur gzigs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des 'jug pa'i cho ga grub nas zhugs nas dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma sogs lan gsum brjod/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru gsum gyi sar/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can rer gsal bar gyur pa'i steng du bla re/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' bskor kun tu mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ phaiṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon zhes pas spyan drangs te/ dbang gi lha mdun gyi nam mkha'i ltos thams cad khyab nas bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ khyed rnams kyi phyogs su bum pa cung zad yo ba dang bcas te me tog gi char phab cing bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs sh+lau ka gsum bya/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha'i gtso mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rigs lngas bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/

slob dpon gyis bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ngag tu ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas spyi gtsug nas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu rab tu gnas pa byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra sogs dang me tog spyi bor bzhag go /des rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba yin/ gsang sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba bye ru'i phreng ba bltar la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad sngags kyi phreng ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ zhal nas 'thon pa'i sngags phreng dang dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid/ khyed rnams rje btsun ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' ma na phar g.yon bskor du dmar 'khyir gyis 'khod par mos pa byas nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan sogs lan gsum brjod/ khyed rnams kyi me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces pa sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ dam bca' ba'i lung blang ba ni/ nyin re la sngags ji tsam bzla ba'i dam bca' khas len du bcug la/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing*/ de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyin re bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chags par dam bca' 'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing*/ de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyi ma re re zhing nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chags par 'don par dam bca' lags so// de rnams brtan pa'i phyir slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis ngag tu oṃ gsum ma brjod do// de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba byin gyis rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsang ba'i dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bha ga nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/

maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ zhes byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas myang bas bdud rtsi des lus thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags rim 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos nas/ de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon= shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la= slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i srin lag gi sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te khyed rnams kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su yas rim gyis reg pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa de khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i bha ga'i nang nas zhugs te lus thams cad la khyab pas rim pa bzhin lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ lte ba nas snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ snying ga nas mgrin par byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos pa byas te/ lus thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab pas nyams myong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid nga yin no zhes pa'i don yin no// de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/

yid kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon= dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyis tshul du bskur ba ni/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal nas dngos po sogs nas bsgom/ zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len par byed pa la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyi snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul tsam du thag bcad/ rang lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i 'dzag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ba de yid yul du byas te/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa thams cad kyis stong pas nam mkha' lta bu ste/ nam mkha' la skye 'gag med pa bzhin sems la skye 'gag med/ nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong med pa bzhin sems la= nam mkha' la rtag chad med pa bzhin sems la= nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin sems la= nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba ltar sems la glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi brji/ nam mkhas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab pa ltar sems kyis 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab ste/ spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo lhod kyis glod nas sems la sems kyis blta ba'i tshul gyis gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon= des dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su sogs rjes kyi chos gsum gzhan dang 'dra'o// des rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo gsan pa yin pas do nub nas bzung ste chags med la sogs pa la yang brtson pa dang*/

rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ slob dpon gyis/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ bstod pa/ 'dod don gsol gdab he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar ro// ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sogs nas badz+ra muḥ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgrin gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ sogs kyis bsrung ngo*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod sogs smon lam dang*/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang chos ldan gyi bya ba sogs la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yig char mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal byed du bdag gi bla mas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams dang*/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog lhun grub la sogs pa mkhas grub rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa/ brang ti ba dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis e wam̐ thar rtser sbyar ba'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// dge'o// dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
